scientific.integrity: The source AGC norm-ratio rule is specialized exactly to a scalar quadratic, producing a continuous three-zone piecewise-linear map. Global convergence below the raw-curvature threshold follows from strict magnitude contraction; failure above it follows from an explicit two-cycle band or outer linear divergence.
limitations: One scalar deterministic unit with plain gradient descent after clipping.
The phase diagram assumes curvature h larger than the AGC clipping parameter.
Momentum, weight decay, stochastic gradients, and vector coupling are outside the claim.
The floorless rule is a formal comparison, not the source default.

title: AGC's parameter-norm floor restores the raw quadratic stability ceiling
